headlines.title: Ten reasons the market is selling off again before Thanksgiving
headlines.snippet: Sozzi Unleashed host Brian Sozzi runs through his list of 10 reasons stocks are selling off again two days after the Jensen Huang relief rally, from a hot PCE report and a possible December Fed hike to new tariffs of up to 20% on China and the EU, and five reasons Nvidia is back under pressure. He questions why Wall Street is shrugging off blowout quarters from Dell and HPE, with HPE CEO Antonio Neri weighing in on server pricing and why the company won't finance neoclouds. Yorkville Ives partner Dan Ives joins to argue the selloff is a growth scare, not a bubble, puts fair value on Anthropic as it trades below its IPO price, and previews Huang's testimony in Washington. Brian closes with Walmart's CFO on turkey sales, a look at retail stocks as gas prices fall for 31 straight days, and a Thanksgiving message to investors.

headlines.title: A 70-Year-Old Moved $815,000 Out of Treasury Bills and Into Dividend ETFs. Here’s What Happened to Her $4,418 Monthly Paycheck
headlines.snippet: Ditching guaranteed Treasury bills for seven dividend ETFs gave one retiree a much bigger monthly check. It also swapped predictability for payouts that can shrink, and one fund quietly drives far more of her income than its size suggests.

headlines.title: SPYD and SCHD Hold No Nvidia. Here’s What You Give Up and What You Get
headlines.snippet: Two dividend ETFs skipped the AI trade entirely and still left the S&P 500 behind this year. The reason has less to do with luck than with where the market quietly shifted, and the trade-offs may surprise income investors.

headlines.title: How Much You’d Need in Dividend Stocks to Generate $5,000 a Month in Passive Income
headlines.snippet: The price tag on a $60,000 dividend paycheck swings by nearly $2 million depending on the yield you chase. Higher payouts shrink the bill, but one tier hides a trap that can gut your income when a cut arrives.

headlines.title: Leaving a Roth IRA to Your Kids? Why Dividend Stocks Make the 10-Year Rule Work for Them
headlines.snippet: One stock in a six-pack of blue-chip dividend payers drives nearly two-fifths of the tax bill on an inherited portfolio, and it belongs somewhere else entirely. Your kids could pay for that mistake for decades.

headlines.title: Japan's biggest banks pick Solana as Fidelity adds DeFi tokens
headlines.snippet: Scott Melker covers a Neuberger Berman high-yield bond fund going live as collateral on Aave Horizon, Kraken's planned credit cards paying up to 4% back in Bitcoin, Gemini enabling shielded Zcash deposits, Coinkite's postmortem on the Coldcard hardware wallet bug, and a "How Not to Invest" segment on a Florida man who used an AI voice clone of a streamer to pull off a $260,000 crypto scam.

headlines.title: Tariffs are back as Anthropic sinks further below its IPO price
headlines.snippet: The 8:30 hosts Julie Hyman and Jake Conley, joined on the couch by BD8 Capital Partners CEO and CIO Barbara Doran, tackle the top stories of the day. Including the Trump administration's sweeping new Section 301 tariffs of 20% on China and dozens of other economies, in-line PCE inflation and a third-quarter GDP revision up to 4.3% that keep a December Fed hike in play, Anthropic sliding toward $78 and well below its $83 IPO price, and whether Jensen Huang is the right leader for Nvidia in a new regulatory era.
